responsibility: This file implements the C front end’s textual GIMPLE function-body parser. It layers a GIMPLE-specific parser over `c_parser` tokens, parses GIMPLE statements, declarations, labels, conditionals, switches, returns, and expressions, builds corresponding GIMPLE statements and sequences, tracks basic-block and edge specifications such as `__BB<n>` labels and profile probabilities, and constructs or updates CFG/SSA-oriented function structure for functions supplied in textual GIMPLE form.
same_name_distinction: This .c file contains the actual textual GIMPLE parser implementation, including the gimple_parser state, statement/expression parsing, basic-block and edge parsing, and CFG-related construction; gcc/c/gimple-parser.h is only the narrow interface that declares the entry points the main C parser uses to invoke this support.
